entry.title: Remember and learn as we go
entry.use_when: Keep useful ideas, decisions and lessons close at hand.
entry.scope: Project-local memory, retrieval and learning from observed work
entry.freshness: Review after failed use or a source/contract change.
entry.limitations: Requires an existing assistant and authorized storage. No automatic model training, background monitoring or cross-session recall.

pattern.activation: a decision, useful idea, correction, connection, open question or proposed measure is worth finding again; also when resuming work or revisiting a related choice.

use_cases.title: Resume work without losing the reasoning
use_cases.outcome: A current-state view backed by dated decisions, open questions and recoverable history.

links.why: Use the portable record format and integrity checks for saved project memory.
Project memory captures and retrieves ongoing context; lesson curation turns a particular correction into a scoped improvement.
